Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:

Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

In your continual harness, entries created without global_=True belong to this session and are lost with it.

Replies without a valid action waste the turn, and a few in a row end the puzzle charged in full.

```
import os,glob,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])   # this instance's own log: the folder keeps every earlier one's
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
```

import json, math
from collections import defaultdict, Counter

def transform(g):
    g=[row[:] for row in g]
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    import numpy as np
    a=np.array(g)
    cnt=np.bincount(a.ravel()); bg=int(cnt.argmax())
    # components 4-conn
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
    objs=[]
    for y in range(H):
        for x in range(W):
            if seen[y][x] or g[y][x]==bg: continue
            c=g[y][x]; st=[(y,x)]; seen[y][x]=True; cl=[]
            while st:
                cy,cx=st.pop(); cl.append((cy,cx))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny,nx=cy+dy,cx+dx
                    if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and not seen[ny][nx] and g[ny][nx]==c:
                        seen[ny][nx]=True; st.append((ny,nx))
            objs.append((c,cl))
    def isL(cl):
        ys={y for y,x in cl}; xs={x for y,x in cl}
        # L = exists corner cell such that all cells in its column-run and row-run
        # check: shape = union of one full vertical segment and one full horizontal segment sharing an endpoint
        from collections import Counter
        colc=Counter(x for y,x in cl); rowc=Counter(y for y,x in cl)
        # vertical bar: column with max run; find corner: cell whose row count==len of horizontal arm etc.
        for (cy,cx) in cl:
            vcol=[y for y in ys if (y,cx) in set(cl)]
            hrow=[x for x in xs if (cy,x) in set(cl)]
            if len(vcol)+len(hrow)-1==len(cl) and set(cl)=={(y,x) for y in vcol for x in []}|{(y,cx) for y in vcol}|{(cy,x) for x in hrow}:
                # check contiguity
                vcol.sort(); hrow.sort()
                if all(vcol[i+1]-vcol[i]==1 for i in range(len(vcol)-1)) and all(hrow[i+1]-hrow[i]==1 for i in range(len(hrow)-1)):
                    if (cy==vcol[0] or cy==vcol[-1]) and (cx==hrow[0] or cx==hrow[-1]):
                        return True
        return False
    from collections import defaultdict
    byc=defaultdict(list)
    for c,cl in objs: byc[c].append(cl)
    Ls=[(c,cl) for c,cl in objs if isL(cl) and len(byc[c])==1]
    if not Ls: return g
    tc,Lcl=max(Ls,key=lambda t:len(t[1]))
    def skey(cl):
        ys=[y for y,x in cl]; xs=[x for y,x in cl]
        return tuple(sorted((y-min(ys),x-min(xs)) for y,x in cl))
    def mind(A,B): return min(math.dist(p,q) for p in A for q in B)
    classes=defaultdict(list)
    for c,cl in objs: classes[skey(cl)].append((c,cl))
    cands=[(len(k),k,v) for k,v in classes.items() if len(v)==2 and len(k)>1
           and not (len(v)==2 and v[0][0]==0 and v[1][0]==0)]
    if not cands: return g
    cands.sort(reverse=True)
    top=cands[0][2]
    # farther member from L
    m0,m1=top
    ch = m0 if mind(m0[1],Lcl)>mind(m1[1],Lcl) else m1
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for y,x in ch[1]: out[y][x]=tc
    return out

    gi=p['input']; oi=comps(gi); ci=Counter(c for c,_ in oi); bg=ci.most_common(1)[0][0]

    for (y,x) in src:

        if v+h-1==len(src): best=(y,x)
    cy,cx=best
    H=len(gi[0]); W=len(gi)
    ys=[y for y,x in src if x==cx]; xs=[x for y,x in src if y==cy]
    dy = 1 if max(ys)==cy else -1   # V arm extends this way from corner

    q=[]
    for c,cl in oi:

        for (y,x) in cl:

def transform(g):
    gi=[r[:] for r in g]; oi=comps(gi); bg=bgc(gi)
    colcount=defaultdict(int)
    for c,cl in oi:
        if c!=bg and len(cl)>1: colcount[c]+=1
    singles=[c for c,k in colcount.items() if k==1]
    assert len(singles)==1, (singles,colcount)
    toc=singles[0]
    src=[cl for c,cl in oi if c==toc and len(cl)>1][0]
    cy,cx,V,Hh,dv,dh=corners_of(src)[0]
    objs=[(c,cl) for c,cl in oi if c!=bg and len(cl)>1 and cl is not src and cl!=src]
    groups=defaultdict(list)
    for c,cl in objs:
        groups[shape_str(cl)].append((c,cl))
    def quad(cl,sgn_y,sgn_x):
        return any((y-cy)*sgn_y>0 and (x-cx)*sgn_x>0 for y,x in cl)
    chosen=None
    for sk,g in groups.items():
        if len(g)!=2: continue
        a,b=g
        qa=(quad(a,dv,dh),quad(a,-dv,-dh)); qb=(quad(b,dv,dh),quad(b,-dv,-dh))
        if qa==(True,False) and qb==(False,True): chosen=b
        elif qb==(True,False) and qa==(False,True): chosen=a
    assert chosen is not None, 'no pair'
    c,cl=chosen
    for y,x in cl: gi[y][x]=toc
    return gi

prog='''import json
from collections import defaultdict, Counter


def comps(g):
    """Return list of (color, cells) 4-connected components."""
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    seen = [[False] * w for _ in range(h)]
    out = []
    for y in range(h):
        for x in range(w):
            if seen[y][x]:
                continue
            c = g[y][x]
            stack = [(y, x)]
            seen[y][x] = True
            cells = []
            while stack:
                cy, cx = stack.pop()
                cells.append((cy, cx))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    ny, nx = cy + dy, cx + dx
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and not seen[ny][nx] and g[ny][nx] == c:
                        seen[ny][nx] = True
                        stack.append((ny, nx))
            out.append((c, cells))
    return out


def bg_of(g):
    return Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]


def corners_of(cells):
    """All (cy, cx, vlen, hlen, dv, dh) interpretations of an L with corner at a bend."""
    s = set(cells)
    ys = [y for y, x in cells]; xs = [x for y, x in cells]
    res = []
    for (cy, cx) in cells:
        v = [y for y in range(min(ys), max(ys) + 1) if (y, cx) in s]
        h = [x for x in range(min(xs), max(xs) + 1) if (cy, x) in s]
        if len(v) < 2 or len(h) < 2:
            continue
        # both arms must be fully present
        if all((y, cx) in s for y in range(min(v), max(v) + 1)) and \
           all((cy, x) in s for x in range(min(h), max(h) + 1)):
            dv = 1 if max(v) > cy else -1
            dh = 1 if max(h) > cx else -1
            res.append((cy, cx, abs(max(v) - min(v)) + 1, abs(max(h) - min(h)) + 1, dv, dh))
    return res


def shape_str(cells):
    ys = [y for y, x in cells]; xs = [x for y, x in cells]
    s = set(cells)
    return '/'.join(''.join('#' if (y, x) in s else '.' for x in range(min(xs), max(xs) + 1))
                    for y in range(min(ys), max(ys) + 1))


def is_l_shape(cells):
    return len(corners_of(cells)) > 0


def transform(g):
    """L marker paints its far same-shape twin: find the L (single multi-cell object of its
    color, L-shaped), then among exact-shape pairs pick the pair with exactly one member in
    the quadrant of the L's arms; recolor the other member to the L's color."""
    gi = [row[:] for row in g]
    comps_ = comps(gi)
    bg = bg_of(gi)
    bycolor = defaultdict(list)
    for c, cl in comps_:
        if c != bg and len(cl) > 1:
            bycolor[c].append(cl)
    singles = [cls[0] for cls in bycolor.values() if len(cls) == 1]
    ls = [cl for cl in singles if is_l_shape(cl)]
    src = max(ls or singles, key=len)
    toc = gi[src[0][0]][src[0][1]]
    cy, cx, _, _, dv, dh = corners_of(src)[0]
    shapes = defaultdict(list)
    for c, cl in comps_:
        if c == bg or len(cl) < 2 or cl == src:
            continue
        shapes[shape_str(cl)].append(cl)

    def in_arm_quad(cl):
        return any((y - cy) * dv > 0 and (x - cx) * dh > 0 for y, x in cl)

    chosen = None
    for sk, g in shapes.items():
        if len(g) != 2:
            continue
        qa, qb = in_arm_quad(g[0]), in_arm_quad(g[1])
        if qa and not qb:
            chosen = g[1]
        elif qb and not qa:
            chosen = g[0]
    assert chosen is not None, 'no qualifying shape pair'
    for y, x in chosen:
        gi[y][x] = toc
    return gi
'''
